status: PARKED -- a runner now exists (see adjudicated_2026_09_02)
origin: Not a hypothesis I went looking for. The exit_manager_replay pin had been RED for weeks; repairing it surfaced that on 2026-07-17 the LIVE bold trade at 13:51:21 made $191, while TODAY's exit config replays it to $114 -- exited by `premium_stop @ 0.61`, and it is the only unfaithful trade of the six. A real winner cut ~40%.
the_question: Does the PRE-TP1 PROFIT RATCHET (1a9b1409) plus J's LADDER (af6cf286) and the +40%->+75% trail arm (658ecc79) cost more in truncated winners than it saves in protected profit, measured across a population rather than one trade?
why_it_is_NOT_obviously_a_bug: Locking profit earlier and capping the runner is the ratchet's INTENDED shape -- it is insurance, and insurance loses money on the days it was not needed. The 08-13 exhibit showed the mirror case (a day that only worked because the contract doubled). One trade cannot distinguish 'working as designed' from 'over-tightened', which is exactly why this is a study and not an edit.
why_the_prior_is_genuinely_two-sided: AGAINST the ratchet: C30 (unconstrained/over-tight exit knobs are this repo's most repeated dead end), C2/L51/L55 (first-strike entries are chart-stop-only precisely because premium stops misfire on 0DTE noise), and the noise-floor finding (10-min MAE -36% vs a -20% stop = winners stopped by noise). FOR the ratchet: J's own directive that runners must not give back open profit, and the cost-recovery law's insurance logic. Expect a TRADE-OFF TABLE, not a winner.

population.source: real-OPRA-fills replay across every date with a 1-min highres cache, NOT the single 2026-07-17 day that generated the question
population.minimum: n>=30 trades per cell or the cell reports NOT-RUN
population.disclosure_required: the generating trade (2026-07-17 bold 13:51:21) must be reported SEPARATELY and excluded from the headline, because a hypothesis cannot be confirmed by the observation that produced it

cells_preregistered.note: exit numeric parameters pinned identically across cells except the ONE knob under test (the strike-A/B pinning rule, deep-review tonight-item #5); report achieved runner fraction after integer rounding

metrics.primary: delta in mean dollar P&L per trade vs ratchet_ON_current
metrics.the_column_that_decides_it: truncated_winner_dollars vs protected_loss_dollars -- the ratchet is insurance, so it must be priced as insurance: what did the premium cost, and what did it pay out?
metrics.test: two-sided permutation, 20000 iterations; BH-FDR q=0.10 across all measured cells

validity_gates.G1_faithfulness_first: the replay must reproduce LIVE fills on the unchanged arm before any counterfactual arm is interpreted. exit_manager_replay currently reports 5/6 faithful -- resolve or disclose that sixth before trusting any cell.
validity_gates.G2_knob_binds: vary-and-assert (C14): n_trades_whose_exit_reason_CHANGED must be >0 in every non-control cell, or the knob is inert and the cell is meaningless.
validity_gates.G3_no_single_trade_drives_it: report the result with the largest-|delta| trade removed. If the sign flips, say so in the headline -- 08-13's own review was distorted exactly this way (one event = 114% of the day).

ship_rule: Nothing ships from this study alone. The ratchet was J-directed under a rule-9 override and is guard-tested; loosening it is a POLICY change that needs J, not a research verdict. The maximum output is a priced trade-off table J can rule on.
declared_expectation_recorded_before_run: The ratchet costs real money on trend days and saves real money on reversal days, netting close to zero with wide variance -- i.e. a NULL on mean P&L with a genuine reduction in downside dispersion. If it shows a large clean positive for either arm, hunt the artifact first (/fable-too-good): the most likely one is a replay whose counterfactual arm silently changes the ENTRY population, not just the exit.

AMENDED_2026_08_15_before_any_run.why: Live exit telemetry (545 attributed actions) showed the mechanism is a COMPOSITION shift, not a P&L level: ribbon_flip_back went 4%->22% of closes, runner_target @ +250% went 3 fires -> 0. Net P&L is the downstream symptom; composition is the cause.
AMENDED_2026_08_15_before_any_run.amendment_is_legitimate_because: no cell of this prereg has been run. Amending an UNRUN prereg on new observational evidence is pre-registration working; amending it after seeing results would be the violation.
AMENDED_2026_08_15_before_any_run.new_primary_metric: exit-reason COMPOSITION per cell: share of closes by {runner_target, runner_stop, ribbon_flip_back, structure_stop, premium_stop, tp1}, reported alongside net P&L.
AMENDED_2026_08_15_before_any_run.the_decisive_number: runner_target fire RATE. It is 0/98 post-stack vs 3/239 pre-stack. If removing the ladder does not restore ANY runner_target fires, the ladder is not what is capping the tail and this whole line of inquiry is wrong.
AMENDED_2026_08_15_before_any_run.new_gate_G5_composition_binds: a cell whose exit-reason composition is unchanged from control did not actually vary the knob (C14) -- report NOT-RUN rather than a P&L delta.

adjudicated_2026_09_02.disposition: PARK with a concrete unblock, not a kill. The question is good and genuinely two-sided by its own construction: does the pre-TP1 profit ratchet plus the ladder and the +40%->+75% trail arm cost more in truncated winners than it saves in protected profit, across a POPULATION rather than the one trade that prompted it (2026-07-17 bold, live $191 vs $114 on today's config, cut by premium_stop @ 0.61)?
adjudicated_2026_09_02.why_it_was_stuck: It was frozen with frozen_before_any_runner=true and no runner was ever written. It needs a faithful population-level exit replay, and at the time there was no harness whose fidelity had been demonstrated.
adjudicated_2026_09_02.what_changed_2026_09_02: There is one now. lib.exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager drives the REAL production exit_manager core, and its V9 validate-the-validator sign agreement went 79.3% -> 89.3% (n=121, bar 85%) once per-row stop_mode and ribbon reconstruction were threaded in -- so the whole-engine null's verdict moved from WITHHELD to PASS. That is exactly the harness this study needs, and it is now demonstrated faithful rather than assumed.
adjudicated_2026_09_02.reopen_condition: Write the runner against lib.exit_manager_walk, replay the population with the ratchet ON vs OFF, and report truncated-winner cost against protected-profit saved. Analysis-only, so freeze-compatible; arming any change is a trading-path edit and waits for 2026-10-30.
